control.name: v46 development stack with the combination member at w 0.40 (v51's model part)

declaration.cost_estimate: about 15 min per fit, two lanes per GPU: about 20 node-hours of fitting plus set-up
declaration.disclosed: Known before this declaration: (1) the October design batch (configs/ctx_ownpoints_design_v1.json, docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints.md, docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints_design_report.json sha256 d23ab9b3...): recipe proxy at b = 0.4 own columns in both networks -0.2442% vs control -0.0731% (interval [-0.46, -0.16] s), matched network only -0.2077%, unmatched only -0.1097%; (2) dig tunnels 15/17/18 read the same own points against 2025 labels of January, July, November and December through the shipped chain (own-motion bounds; stack_resid_v3, built and uploaded as v63); stack_resid_v3 already carries this information, so the overlap is tested in stage 2; (3) the official scores of v51-v64 exist; nothing here is derived from them. The candidates (both routings of the design batch), the weight grid (the combination round's 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.40) and the rules are fixed by those earlier records.

fits.extra_features: data/external/adsblol/features_v19own (manifest sha256 0e8811e6..., docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints_features_manifest.json; 14 tables hash-checked on 4 October before this declaration): the 11 v19 columns byte-identical to features_v19 plus the 15 own columns
fits.footing: as the combination round: January and July 2025 leave-one-month-out on the other eleven months; November the forward fold (reported only); December the January-November refit; ranking the twelve-month refit
fits.runner: tools/run_adsb_ctx_lomo.py, unchanged; jobs tools/combo_jobs.py --declaration; queue tools/combo_queue.sh with EXTRA=data/external/adsblol/features_v19own (the queue's EXTRA option added for this round, default behaviour unchanged)

declaration.hardware: up to four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each) via SkyPilot (infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20261004.json), --device cuda, float32 with TF32, two lanes per GPU, as the combination round. If AWS supplies fewer nodes the same fits run on fewer nodes of the same type.

member.external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL), as every network of the table; the own columns come from the same archive (tools/build_ownpoints_features.py)
member.name: own_all

members_derived.own_matched: per seed and leaf: own_all's table on rows with adsb_matched = 1 (dl32own), the shipped combination member's table (runs/adsb_ctx3_combo/member/s<seed>/<leaf>.parquet, m25dl32) on the other rows; same seeds 601-616; built by tools/run_ctx_ownpoints_dev.py into runs/ctx_ownpoints_dev/member_matched/ and hash-recorded

declaration.never_read: No official score enters. The published-aggregates sources enter only through the shipped chain's layers with their shipped parameters in stage 2.
declaration.purpose: Development round of the context-network member with the 15 own-aircraft turnaround columns (dig tunnel 21, docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints.md). The member REPLACES the shipped combination member (configs/adsb_ctx3_combo_dev_v1.json, w40, in v51 onwards) inside the committee's network table. Declared before any fit of these networks and before any development score; modelled on configs/adsb_ctx3_combo_dev_v1.json (same seeds count, folds, months, scorer arithmetic and rule).
declaration.rule: stage 1: the clean line's unchanged rule against that control: eligible when no equal-footing month (January, July, December) is worse on all rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1 and every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; the lowest mean ratio among the eligible is selected; otherwise nothing.
declaration.semantics: Stage 1 (member level, tools/run_ctx_ownpoints_dev.py, arithmetic of tools/run_network_member.py): control = the v46 development stack with the shipped combination member at w 0.40 in the network table (v51's model part; its month RMSEs must equal docs/adsb_ctx3_combo/results_v1.json w40 before any candidate is read). Candidate = the same stack with the combination member REMOVED and the candidate member in its place: table' = (1 - w) nets + w member seed mean on non-LIRF rows where both are finite; v46's mix (network share 0.85, share 0.5 where the committee sits more than 1,200 s above table'); then the whole v46 development stack.

stage_2_in_chain.build: if both stages pass: the ranking file through the same chain (ranking member tables from the twelve-month refit), built as the next free version on runs/submissions at the user's standing word ('if you get anything build and keep it ready, we will upload it when slots reset'; 'Start it on the GPU'), audited against the latest built file; never uploaded by this round
stage_2_in_chain.candidate: the development model part rebuilt with the selected member in place of the combination member (tools/build_dev_model_part.py arithmetic: v51m step with the selected member and weight; v52m-v55m layers unchanged), then the shipped chain with its shipped parameters: no-NM rematch, v48 reconciliation, extreme-day layer, variance re-allocation, stack_resid_v3 refitted on the rebuilt components with its declared settings (configs/stack_resid_v3.json), intruder bound, identity extension, own-motion v1, own-motion v2 (each month-blocked as its tool does)
stage_2_in_chain.control: the v64 development proxy: the v63 development proxy (runs/stack_resid/dev_v63_proxy.parquet, column v63, sha256 1628a1d6...) with own_motion_v2 (configs/own_motion_v2.json) applied last by tools/run_own_motion_v2.py's arithmetic
stage_2_in_chain.rule: v57's clauses 1-3: no development month worse by more than 0.005%; equal-footing mean at most -0.02%; every equal-footing paired-day 95% interval below zero. Clause 4 (twelve months) does not apply: the stacker's components exist only for the four development months (as stack_resid_v2 / v3).
stage_2_in_chain.when: only if stage 1 selects a candidate
